reading: In one sample each, with the same user prompt, the small model failed where Claude succeeded; Claude ran under Claude Code's own system prompt, Mistral under a one-line system prompt at temperature 0 with JSON mode. Model capacity is a hypothesis, not an established finding. The original wrong t1 conclusion (unchanged) is consistent with a model-capacity limit, but one replay per model does not establish it.
